title: Coronavirus Optimization Algorithm: A Success-History Adaptive Evolutionary Framework with Archive-Assisted Search and Stagnation Recovery for Global Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.23847v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper proposes the Coronavirus Optimization Algorithm (COA), a SARS-CoV-2-inspired success-history adaptive evolutionary optimizer for box-constrained continuous global optimization. COA does not model disease transmission; instead, it maps selected coronavirus mechanisms to explicit search operators, including elite-guided attraction, trial-vector generation, adaptive parameter variation, stagnation recovery, and population-size scheduling. The algorithm combines opposition-based initialization, current-to-pbest mutation, binomial crossover, an external archive, success-history adaptation, population reduction, and partial restart. COA is evaluated on 29 CEC 2017 benchmark functions at 10, 30, and 50 dimensions against 15 competitive optimizers. translated_title: 冠状病毒优化算法：一种带有存档辅助搜索和停滞恢复机制的成功历史自适应进化框架，用于全局优化
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.23847v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：本文提出了冠状病毒优化算法（COA），这是一种受SARS-CoV-2启发的成功历史自适应进化优化器，用于解决有界约束的连续全局优化问题。COA不模拟疾病传播机制，而是将选定的冠状病毒机制映射为显式搜索操作符，包括精英引导吸引、试验向量生成、自适应参数变化、停滞恢复和种群规模调度。该算法结合了基于对立性的初始化、当前到最优变异、二项式交叉、外部存档、成功历史自适应、种群缩减和部分重启。COA在10、30和50维度的29个CEC 2017基准函数上进行了评估，并与15种竞争优化器进行了比较。结果表明，COA在所有维度上取得了最佳的整体弗里德曼排名，尤其在组合函数上表现突出。研究结果证明COA是一种高效的优化算法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种受SARS-CoV-2启发的成功历史自适应进化优化算法（COA），通过结合对立初始化、当前到最优变异、外部存档和停滞恢复等机制，在CEC 2017基准测试中显著优于15种竞争优化器，特别是在高维组合函数上表现卓越。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a SARS-CoV-2-inspired success-history adaptive evolutionary optimizer (COA) that integrates opposition-based initialization, current-to-pbest mutation, external archive, and stagnation recovery, achieving superior performance over 15 competitors on CEC 2017 benchmarks, especially for high-dimensional composition functions.
